title: Reservation Settings Sheet: Booking Requests, Instant Book and Changes to a Stay
content:
# Reservation settings — booking requests, Instant Book and changes to a stay

The settings below govern booking requests and date or guest-count changes on reservations in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category. They are identical on all eight cancellation policies (Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days and Long-Term).

| Setting | Value on every policy |
|---|---|
| Elapsed hours after a request-to-book stay was booked after which the unaccepted request expires | 24 |
| Listing on this policy may accept stays by Instant Book | Yes |
| Elapsed hours the host has to accept a date or guest-count change request before it lapses | 24 |
| How nights removed by an accepted change are refunded | as if those nights were cancelled by the guest on the date the host accepted the change |
| A stay in progress may still be changed | Yes |
| Nightly price of nights added by a change | the listing nightly rate in effect when the host accepts the change |

## Illustration (hypothetical times)

- A hypothetical request-to-book stay booked at 09:00 on 2026-05-10 is open for the host's acceptance for 24 elapsed hours, until 09:00 on 2026-05-11.
- A hypothetical change request submitted at 18:30 on 2026-06-02 lapses unless the host accepts it within 24 elapsed hours, by 18:30 on 2026-06-03.
- If a change accepted on 2026-06-03 removes two nights, those two nights are refunded as if the guest had cancelled them on 2026-06-03; if it adds a night, the added night is priced at the listing's nightly rate in effect on acceptance.
